title: WorkPulse candidate.created v1
description: HR added a candidate application to an open job. Identifiers and the intake source only — candidate names, emails, phones and notes are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

candidate_id.description: The created candidate application (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012 — candidate fallback).

job_id.description: The job the candidate applied to (UUIDv7 string).

source.description: How the candidate reached the pipeline (intake channel code only).
